description: A shell script for managing a local Kubernetes cluster with kind, including creation and deletion of clusters, auto-detection of container engine (docker or podman), and server configuration options.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Outputs an informational message in blue color.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Outputs a success message in green color.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Outputs a warning message in yellow color.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message in red color and exits.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: provider_installed
methods.description: Checks if a container engine (docker/podman) is installed.

methods.name: provider_responsive
methods.description: Checks if the container engine daemon/responds.

methods.name: detect_provider
methods.description: Detects the available container engine (docker or podman).
